Package de.abas.ceks.jedp Description

This package contains interfaces and classes to access abas ERP using the EDP interface.

The JEDP interface implements operations in a generic manner, i.e. there aren't any ERP objects, but generic objects like EDPSession, EDPQuery, EDPEditor etc.

Since:
abas Version 10.2, EDP Version 2.1
